label: Trapezoid Pocket
description: The trapezoid chest pocket departs from both the rectangle and the arc by cutting the welt or pocket opening as a trapezoid — wider at the top than the bottom — producing a shape that tapers as it descends and creates a subtle visual wedge effect on the chest. This creates a quiet visual wedge effect that can slim and elongate the torso, and is associated with avant-garde or highly individualistic bespoke commissions. It is an uncommon feature that functions as a quiet signature for tailors who enjoy subverting conventional geometry.

garment.fabric: fine wool suiting with visible weave
